description: Rerank search results or RAG chunks by relevance to a query: JSON body {query, documents, top_k}. Up to 50 documents (strings or {id, text}), each up to 2,000 chars. Returns the documents sorted by a 0-1 relevance score from the bge-reranker-base cross-encoder. Texts are not stored. Price $0.005 USDC per call via x402. Example output: {"documents":3,"returned":2,"model":"baai/bge-reranker-base","results":[{"rank":1,"index":0,"score":0.9312,"text":"Photosynthesis turns light, water and carbon dioxide into sugar."},{"rank":2,"index":2,"score":0.4105,"text":"Chlorophyll absorbs sunlight in leaves."}]}

documents.description: 1 to 50 strings or {id, text} objects, each max 2,000 characters

top_k.description: Optional number of results, default all

name: text_rerank
